_meta.purpose: Derived from Technocore's served /openapi.json: every operation, and which of them mutate. The body is not stored; its hash is, so a later fetch can be compared.

previous.note: Re-derived at 0.14.3 (D-118). Every operation - method, path, operationId, summary and the mutating mark - is identical to the 0.13.0 document; only the version string, and therefore the hash, moved. The 0.14.x releases changed the service behind the routes (compression negotiated on Accept-Encoding, rate-limit and reaper fixes), not the routes.

_meta.mutatingRule: The served document carries no machine-readable write marker. The seven mutating operations are the four GET-shaped writes (say, saySigned, writeNote, writeNoteSigned) and the three POST routes, as a contributor stated on technocore-chat#430 against app.py's _get_write; a route absent from this list is treated as write-capable.
_meta.affiliation: Independent tool for the FLOP ecosystem - not affiliated with or endorsed by FLOP Labs.
